question: Which Indian athlete won first silver medal in weightlifting at Tokyo Olympics 2020 held in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mirabai Chanu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Saikhom Mirabai Chanu is a weightlifter who hails from Manipur, India.

 
 
• She competed in the women’s 49-kilogram division at the Olympic Games in Tokyo in 2020 and earned the silver medal.
 
• Because of her hard work and dedication to the sport, the government of India honored her with the Padma Shri award in 2018.
 
• In 2018, the Government of India honored her with Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna for her achievements in the athletic world.
 
• Mirabai Chanu won the first gold for India with a combined lift of 201kg in the Women's 49kg weightlifting final at the Commonwealth Games 2022 in Birmingham on July 30, 2022.
